lines.text: The whole world had one language, and people journeying eastward settled on a plain in the land of Goshen.
The people made bricks and baked them thoroughly, using brick instead of stone and tar instead of mortar.
They planned a city with a tower reaching to the heavens, to make a name for themselves and not be scattered.
The LORD came down to see the city and the tower, and said He would go down and break their bricks.
The LORD scattered them over the face of all the earth, and the city was called Babel.
